requirement:
HC's FIXME review uses an agent criterion to assess whether each linked issue's
title and opening post describe the FIXME's acknowledged gap. It selects the
FIXME's tracking-issue edges through the SDK's tracked interface and supplies
the FIXME and selected issue contents through tracked reads or ask insertions.

A completed assessment that an issue is unrelated fails that issue's relevance
check.
rationale: Add tests marked {test}`requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes.related`. They should use an SDK-level harness with a stubbed or recorded agent so no real agent is needed. (1) Build a FIXME review for a FIXME that has several tracking-issue edges, plus at least one non-tracking edge. Assert that exactly the tracking edges are selected through the SDK's tracked interface. (2) Assert that the delivered inputs contain the FIXME's content and each selected issue's title and opening post, through tracked reads or ask insertions. (3) Run a completed assessment that says an issue is unrelated, and assert that the relevance check fails for that issue. (4) Run a completed assessment that says the issue is related, and assert that the check passes. (5) With several linked issues, assert that only the unrelated one fails. — The reference set for `requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes.related` has no {test} sites, and a search of the sources found no test that exercises it. None of its obligations are checked: tracking-edge selection, supplying the FIXME and issue contents, and failing the relevance check on an 'unrelated' verdict. The one acknowledgment is the {fixme} on `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]`, which names nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem#26. That issue is closed, so it no longer acknowledges the gap.
